subject: RFI: Monitoring & Misuse Detection — BlueBridge financial evidence pack
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluebridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluebridge.com
Date: 2027-06-22T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: RFI: Monitoring, Misuse Detection & Reporting (BlueBridge)

Evelyn —

Thanks for taking this. BlueBridge is preparing our vendor security & operations RFI focused on content safety, misuse monitoring, and incident reporting. We have a concentrated set of questions around:
- real-time detection coverage for financial misuse (fraud/laundering prompts),
- telemetry retention & sampling policies,
- alerting and on-call escalation SLAs, and
- evidence we can present to our internal risk committee.

Deadline: we'd like a consolidated response and supporting artifacts by EOD Wednesday (Jun 23). Ideally the pack includes a short narrative, a matrix of what signals you capture, representative screenshots or exported alerts, and any SOC2/attestation links.

Can Redwood provide a package we can share with our risk & procurement teams? If possible, include contact for a technical follow-up.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Senior Sourcing Manager
BlueBridge Financial
[samantha.lee@bluebridge.com]

[Attachment: bluebridge_rfi_outline.docx (DOCX, 24KB)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluebridge.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-22T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Monitoring, Misuse Detection & Reporting (BlueBridge)

Samantha —

Appreciate the outline. We can assemble a targeted package that includes:
- a concise narrative addressing detection coverage for high-risk financial misuse,
- our misuse-observability matrix (signals, sources, and detection heuristics),
- sample alert exports and a screenshot of the incident dashboard,
- retention & telemetry sampling policies, and
- SOC 2 and penetration test summaries / links.

We'll pull in the security & product owners — cc'd — to validate technical details. One quick ask: do you need FHIR/PCI-specific logs redacted in any way before sharing with your committee? Also, confirm whether the procurement team needs a signed NDA before we attach screenshots containing customer metadata.

I'll circulate the draft by end of day tomorrow; Marissa will lead the artifact packaging.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Solutions — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147]

[Attachment: redwood_rfi_response_template.docx (DOCX, 18KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-22T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: BlueBridge RFI artifacts & asks

Evelyn / team —

I pulled together the first-pass assets for BlueBridge. Drafts attached: misuse-observability-matrix.xlsx and a short narrative that maps our detection capabilities to common financial misuse patterns (money-laundering prompts, account takeover prompts, instruction-to-facilitate fraud).

Notes / open items:
- Telemetry retention: default retention is 90 days for full request+response; we retain aggregated token-level metrics for 365 days. We can offer extended retention for Dedicated/Private customers under contract.
- Sampling policy: continuous sampling at 100% for flagged flows (as defined by routing rules); 1% sampling for low-risk background traffic for long-term trend analysis.
- Alerts: we export to PagerDuty with severity mapping (P0-P3). SLA for on-call ack is 15 minutes for P0/P1 customers (enterprise tier).
- Evidence: included a sample-alert-screenshot.png (sanitized) and a CSV export of a recent alert batch (anonymized).

Open questions for Karthik/Jonas: please confirm kernel-level indicators we surface (KV-cache anomalies, latency spikes tied to sequence truncation) and whether we should include the model-variant fallback playbook as part of the incident runbook.

I'll prep a one-page summary for Samantha and a Drive link.

Marissa
Principal Product Manager, Safety
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: misuse-observability-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 46KB); sample-alert-screenshot.png (PNG, 249KB); alert-batch-export.csv (CSV, 58KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: BlueBridge RFI artifacts & asks

Quick answers —
- Kernel/serving indicators: we surface per-request model-variant id, KV-cache hit/miss rates, per-batch latency histograms, and sequence-length outliers. Include a short note that KV-cache anomalies have been effective signal for replay-style misuse attempts.
- Fallback playbook: yes, include the model-variant fallback and region failover flow (we automatically route to compatible quantized variant on capacity shortfall; manual escalation triggers a canary rollback).
- Redaction: screenshots are fine as long as they are sanitized (no customer IDs, IPs).

I'll add two one-paragraph callouts for the narrative to strengthen our position on detection sensitivity vs. false positives.

Karthik
Director, Applied ML — Safety & Monitoring
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluebridge.com>, procurement@bluebridge.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-23T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Monitoring, Misuse Detection & Reporting (BlueBridge) — submitted package

Samantha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround window. Attached is the BlueBridge RFI package from Redwood. Highlights in the package: 
- 2-page narrative mapping our detection signals to financial misuse scenarios,
- misuse-observability-matrix.xlsx that lists signals, detection confidence, false-positive guidance, and responder actions,
- sanitized alert screenshot and a CSV export of recent anonymized alerts,
- statement of telemetry retention and sampling policy, and
- links to our SOC 2 Type II summary and latest penetration test report (redacted).

Attachment list: redwood_rfi_monitoring_answers.pdf; misuse-observability-matrix.xlsx; sample-alert-screenshot.png.

Per your question: we did not include any raw customer identifiers — all screenshots and CSV rows were sanitized. If BlueBridge requires a signed NDA prior to receiving any non-redacted artifacts, let us know and we can route that to Legal.

If the risk committee would like a short technical walkthrough, Karthik and Jonas are available tomorrow (Jun 24) between 09:00–13:00 PT. Let me know what works and we'll set up a 30-minute call.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Solutions — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
